meta.title: AiR — open-source AI agent platform with privacy and realtime voice
meta.description: Open-source AI agent platform: bots for Telegram, WhatsApp and Avito, realtime voice calls, bring your own API keys. $1/mo covers server resources — zero markup on AI tokens.

hero.titleLine2: Privacy, open source and realtime voice
hero.lead: Run smart bots on Telegram, WhatsApp and Avito, or embed a chat widget straight into your own website. Make calls with voice cloning and plug in your own API keys.
hero.leadStrong: $1 per month pays for server resources and the developer's work — not for AI tokens: those you pay the provider directly with your own keys.
hero.openSource: Source code is open — verify it yourself
hero.visualAlt: Demo of a voice AI agent answering an incoming call

trust.title: Why you can trust us
trust.note: The encryption key is derived from your MasterKey password and available only to you. We never store it and cannot recover your data.
trust.providersHint: You connect your own API keys. Tokens are paid to the provider directly — we add no markup.
